text:
maya: Quick sync: night deploy 22:00 UTC for runtime+router+console. Canary 10m. Need pins/flags from owners. @sam @jordan @alex @priya

sam: Runtime 3.5.0-rc w/ eviction fix. Pin to canary only, keep 3.4.x fallback.

jordan: Router header-split depends on console contract v2. Will gate with flag header-split=false for canary.

alex: Console backend ok for v2; admin UI needs mapping — will delay UI deploy.

priya: API OK. Recommend gateway TTL=60s for KV warmup.

maya: Agreed. Action: sam pin runtime canary; jordan set flag; alex hold UI; priya set TTL. Release notes mention eviction & header toggle.

sam: Pinned: `orchctl pin --service runtime --version 3.5.0-rc --scope canary`

deploy-bot: Canary starting in 10m.

(deploy)
jordan: Seeing p95 bump on auth-proxy +50ms.

sam: KV eviction spikes on warmup, transient.

alex: Admin API 502 spike to 1.9% for ~90s, looks like handshake timeouts to router.

maya: Thresholds: error >2% for 3m or p95>300ms for 2m -> rollback.

jordan: auth-proxy p95 hit 330ms for 2m.

maya: Rollback decision: execute.
sam: Rolling back runtime to 3.4.2: `orchctl rollback --service runtime --to-version 3.4.2 --reason "canary p95 & 502s"`

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress. Unsetting header-split flag.

ops: Metrics normalizing; p95 returned under baseline.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary aborted.

maya: Postmortem: investigate console-router handshake under header-split and add controlled KV warmup. Update release notes: 3.5.0-rc blocked pending perf fixes.

sam: Follow-ups: add eviction-burst metric and extend canary ramp by 5m next attempt.

maya: Scheduling post-deploy sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Thread closed.
